settings.heading: Your prenatal has 300 mg DHA. One Ora King portion has 3,430 mg.

settings.text:
Pregnancy is the one case where the mercury-versus-omega-3 trade-off actually matters, and it is the reason the FDA publishes a “Best Choice” tier at all: maximum omega-3s, minimum mercury.

Ora King’s last harvest tested at 0.017 ppm mercury — roughly 1/59th of the FDA’s 1.0 ppm action level — while delivering about 11× the DHA of a standard prenatal capsule per serving. You do not have to choose between the two, and you do not have to take our word for it: the lab report ships with the box.

settings.heading: What we test
settings.text: Mercury and microplastics on every harvest lot, plus EPA+DHA, protein, selenium and vitamin D per serving. Third-party labs — Edacious and Light Labs — not our own bench.

settings.heading: What we don’t
settings.text: We test per harvest lot, not per individual portion, and results describe the samples analyzed. We do not screen for every heavy metal — mercury is the one that matters most in seafood, so it is the one we hold a ceiling on.
